script:
On September 8, Oor—a man involved in a bitter feud with Angela—made a cruel remark about her deceased baby in a Space I was hosting. Sav was listening. According to her message to Angela, I immediately warned Oor to stop and removed him from the panel. Angela later acknowledged that I'd done so.

Nothing excuses what Oor said. Yet Angela went on to cite what happened in my room when she announced a broadcast devoted to exposing private messages from Sav's and my relationship.

It was called Petty Space. She was about to publish screenshots in batches.

Picture what that means for the person whose messages are being read: something said in a moment of insecurity or anger, which was never meant for strangers, now becoming the subject of a live broadcast.

Angela said she was exposing abusive behavior. That was her public explanation. Sav said she had confided those messages to a friend and didn't want them released.

Angela also described how she would keep more information in reserve until people responded.

This is what she said after one of the batches. The laughter is directed at me. But the private information making that moment possible came from Sav.

And as the broadcast continued, Angela warned the people listening that they were under investigation.

Angela gave more than one explanation for the disclosures. One involved the insult in my room. Another involved her claim that she was confronting abuse.

In a separate September 8 conversation, she said something I'd told her had triggered her, and that she had sent a screenshot to prove me wrong.

Listen to her describe that decision.

Taken together, those accounts describe an escalation.

First, Sav says private screenshots were shared against her wishes in August. By September 2, I was already saying publicly that Angela had posted screenshots, though that recording doesn't identify precisely which ones.

Then, on September 8, Angela made the release itself the subject of a broadcast. She announced batches of four and said she'd keep more messages in reserve.
